interface.shortDescription: Live marketing data and ad campaign management.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Supermetrics to query live marketing data from Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Shopify, HubSpot and other advertising, analytics, e-commerce and CRM platforms, explore available metrics and dimensions, create and update ad campaigns, and publish live dashboards — all via natural language. A 14-day free trial is created automatically on first login, no credit card required.
